title: .azp-local.yml
description: Local-run settings for the Azure Pipelines Local Runner. Every key is optional.

pipelines.description: Extra files to treat as pipelines, beyond those detected by content.

images.description: Pool name or vmImage label -> container image, or "host" to run on this machine without isolation.

repositories.description: resources.repositories alias -> local folder, for templates and checkouts from other repositories.

parameters.description: Values for the pipeline's template parameters.

variables.description: Plain variables and predefined-variable overrides, for example Build.Reason: PullRequest.

variableGroups.description: Local values for variable groups. A secret is declared as { secret: true }; its value is prompted for and kept in the keychain.

tasks.description: What to do with tasks that cannot run locally, keyed by Name@Version or Name.

script.description: Script in the repository to run in place of the task. Inputs arrive as INPUT_<NAME>.

path.description: Folder holding the task's task.json; its Node handler is run.

workspace.description: copy (default): a job gets a copy of tracked and unignored files. mount: bind the working tree for speed; steps then change your files.

dockerSocket.description: Mount the Docker socket into job containers. Off by default: code with the socket can act as root on the host.
